items.title: Taiwan's Hermes Testing Solutions Posts October Profit Up More Than 5-Fold Year-on-Year, EPS NT$5.46, Yet Shares Still Plunge 6.51% in a Single Session
items.why: Taiwan's Hermes Testing Solutions posted a sharp year-on-year profit rise for October, but its shares fell.
